grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings (exceeds C threshold of max_p1=2). Active-plan spec coverage 100%, canonical spec ~8% traced.
skip_reason: Services not running; static-analysis mode only for this audit.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read / Remote Code Execution
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker reaches exposed Vitest UI server (localhost:51204+); crafted request reads /etc/passwd or ../secrets; follow-up executes arbitrary code in test-runner process.
escalations.impact: Full filesystem read and potential code execution on any machine running vitest --ui on an accessible network interface.
escalations.fix: Upgrade vitest ≥3.2.6 in all three projects; enforce `vitest run` (no --ui) in CI.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Malicious .proto Files
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker provides a crafted .proto option value to orchestrator's loadSync()/load(); protobufjs deserialization executes attacker-controlled code in the orchestrator process.
escalations.impact: Arbitrary code execution in the pipeline orchestrator — the infrastructure that runs all agent pipelines. Full process compromise.
escalations.fix: Upgrade protobufjs ≥7.6.5; vendor all .proto files; never load .proto from untrusted sources.
fix_commands: grep -r 'loadSync\|load' platform/orchestrator/ # audit all .proto load sites

p1_findings.title: Stale Canonical Spec — 77+ Requirements Describe a Deprecated Platform
p1_findings.failure_scenario: Future agent reads Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, treats FR-001–FR-069 as active requirements, implements features for a system that no longer exists, or wrongly fails traceability audits.
p1_findings.impact: Misleads all future agents and solo sessions; CLAUDE.md rule 'specs are source of truth' enforced on a zombie document.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add DEPRECATED banner to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md OR write Specifications/self-judging-workflow.md and retire the old spec.

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Directly Import workItemStore — Service Layer Bypassed
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Swapping the in-memory store for a real DB requires editing every route file; route unit tests cannot isolate store behavior.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract WorkItemService wrapping all store CRUD. Route handlers import the service only.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Never Checks Specifications/ — Emits False Green
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Enforcer reports PASSED while 93 canonical spec FRs are completely untraced. Agents trust the green signal.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Specifications/ scan mode; at minimum add warning comment to enforcer script.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-search: /api/search Endpoint Not Wired in app.ts
p2_findings.failure_scenario: DependencyPicker component sends GET /api/search?q=; server returns 404; dependency typeahead search is broken in the UI.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement search handler (filter workItemStore by title/description) and register in app.ts.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry Prometheus Exporter Crash on Malformed Request
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Malformed HTTP request to /metrics endpoint crashes the portal/Backend process; observability lost.

p2_findings.title: Vite fs.deny Bypass — Path Traversal on Windows Dev Environments
p2_findings.failure_scenario: On Windows dev machines, crafted request bypasses Vite fs.deny and reads files outside project root (e.g., .env, private configs).

p2_findings.title: Brace-Expansion DoS via Exponential Pattern Expansion (4 CVEs)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Pathological glob pattern passed to jest internals causes CPU exhaustion and infinite loop in test runner or any code using this transitive dep.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade jest and ts-jest to pull brace-expansion ≥1.1.18

p2_findings.title: js-yaml CPU Exhaustion via Merge Keys (3 CVEs)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Malicious YAML with deeply nested merge keys causes quadratic CPU consumption in any code path that parses untrusted YAML.

p2_findings.title: gRPC-JS Process Crash via Malformed Message (2 CVEs)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Malformed gRPC message crashes the orchestrator process; pipeline management unavailable.

p2_findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection via Unescaped Field Names
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker-controlled field name containing \r\n injects arbitrary HTTP headers into multipart form submissions.

p2_findings.title: Nanoid Infinite Loop via Negative/Zero Size (2 CVEs)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Passing zero or negative size to nanoid generator causes an infinite loop, hanging the process.

p2_findings.title: WebSocket Memory/CPU Exhaustion via Tiny Fragmented Messages (2 CVEs)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends many tiny fragmented WS messages; server accumulates them in memory until OOM or CPU saturation.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade ws ≥8.21.0; set maxPayload limit on all WebSocket connections.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via Multiple Route Parameters
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Route with multiple optional parameters triggers exponential regex backtracking on pathological input, blocking the event loop.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade express to 4.22.2+ or 5.x to pull patched path-to-regexp.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate Test Files — Root tests/ vs tests/pages/ Without Verifies Comments
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates; treat tests/pages/ as canonical.

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed Not Implemented — Store Always Starts Empty
p3_findings.recommendation: Add store/seed.ts called from app.ts startup (guarded by NODE_ENV !== 'test').

p3_findings.title: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in Production Source
p3_findings.recommendation: Fix dependency arrays or add documented reason comments.

p3_findings.title: WorkItemDetailPage.tsx at 426 Lines — Approaching 500-Line Split Threshold
p3_findings.recommendation: Extract ActionButtons, AssessmentCard, HistoryEntry into Source/Frontend/src/components/.

p3_findings.title: 31 Moderate-Severity Dependency Vulnerabilities (grouped)
p3_findings.note: See Teams/TheInspector/findings/AUDIT_REPORT_2026-08-28.md for full list. Includes qs DoS, body-parser, and build-tooling transitive chain.
p3_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit and address per remediation timeline in dep audit report.

p4_findings.title: 6 Low-Severity Dependency Vulnerabilities (grouped)
p4_findings.recommendation: Monitor; fix opportunistically during routine dependency updates.
